cases.name: local-channel
cases.source:
module provenance;
fn main()->i64 !{task,throw}{return with_tasks(1,fn(s:task_scope)->i64 !{task}{try{throw(channel_new<i64>(s,1));}catch(q:channel<i64>){assert(task_send(q,42));return unwrap(task_recv(q));}});}

cases.name: borrowed-outer
cases.source:
module provenance;
fn main()->i64 !{task,throw}{return with_tasks(1,fn(outer:task_scope)->i64 !{task,throw}{let q:channel<i64>=channel_new<i64>(outer,1);try{with_tasks(1,fn(inner:task_scope)->unit !{throw}{throw(q);});}catch(e:channel<i64>){assert(task_send(e,42));return unwrap(task_recv(e));}catch(c,m){return 0;}return 0;});}

cases.name: local-closure
cases.source:
module provenance;
fn main()->i64 !{task,throw}{return with_tasks(1,fn(s:task_scope)->i64 !{task}{let q:channel<i64>=channel_new<i64>(s,1);try{throw(fn()->i64 !{task}{assert(task_send(q,42));return unwrap(task_recv(q));});}catch(f:fn()->i64 !{task}){return f();}});}

cases.name: filter-decline
cases.source:
module provenance;
fn no()->bool{return false;}fn main()->unit !{task,throw}{with_tasks(1,fn(s:task_scope)->unit !{task,throw}{try{throw(channel_new<i64>(s,1));}catch(q:channel<i64>) if no(){return;}});}

cases.name: predicate-replacement
cases.source:
module provenance;
fn replace()->bool !{throw}{throw(42);}fn main()->i64 !{task,throw}{try{return with_tasks(1,fn(s:task_scope)->i64 !{task,throw}{try{throw(channel_new<i64>(s,1));}catch(q:channel<i64>) if replace(){return 0;}catch(i:i64){return 0;}});}catch(i:i64){return i;}catch(c,m){return 0;}}
